config.//: Tail restaurant-service's database; one connector per service DB (DB-per-service).
config.plugin.name: pgoutput
config.slot.name: restaurant_outbox_slot
config.publication.name: restaurant_outbox_pub
config.//table: Capture ONLY the transactional outbox table (rule 3: publish via the outbox).
config.//router: The outbox event router: each outbox row becomes a Kafka record on a topic
config.//router2: named for its event_type (e.g. SaleRecorded), keyed by aggregate_id, with the
config.//router3: row's bytea Avro `payload` as the message value (shipped verbatim).
config.//topic: Route to a topic named exactly after the event_type (no prefix), so the value
config.//topic2: lands on `SaleRecorded` — the topic finance-service's @KafkaListener subscribes to.
config.//headers: Expose the outbox row id + company_id as Kafka headers. The consumer dedupes by
config.//headers2: the `id` header (the durable event id), not by Kafka offset (HR-3).
config.//converters: payload is raw Avro bytes already — ship the value as a byte array verbatim;
config.//converters2: no Connect-side Avro/JSON conversion (consistent with how the outbox stores it).
config.//tombstones: An outbox is append-only and never deletes, so no tombstones are emitted.
